note: Rawbank, the Congo's largest bank by deposits and its best-known card issuer, was read; Equity BCDC's and TMB's card terms weren't reached. Rawbank's standard tariff (T1 2026, updated 15 January 2026, before VAT, whose rate it doesn't state): its personal Mastercard credit cards, the Standard, Titanium, Platinum and Maximus LF (Lady's First), cost 49, 100, 175 and 100 dollars a year; the Maximus Titanium is for small businesses and isn't written. Its cards page calls the Mastercard a deferred-debit card, whose spending is settled in full, so nothing is carried on them. The tariff's 'Fee Forex' of 3% (at least 10 dollars) is marked 'autre banque' and sits beside the balance enquiry and payment lines, so it reads as a charge for use at another bank and isn't written as the foreign spending share. Wave 4 (30 October 2026), for a second and third bank: Equity BCDC's site answered an Incapsula check and TMB's a Cloudflare 403; Standard Bank RDC's and Afriland First Bank's sites link no tariff, Ecobank RDC's answered a captcha, and Access Bank RDC's, FBN Bank RDC's and BGFIBank RDC's didn't answer. So Rawbank stays the only bank written.
